experiment: Hard-scene benchmark: does IQLD (offline distill + online Cal-QL) exceed the game-theory expert on 'hard' (far1) scenes?
scene: preset 'hard' (=far1): interceptor 1.60-1.85 ahead, flanks 1.10-1.35 fwd / 1.10-1.40 lat, spawn band 1.30-2.10 m. Expert baseline measured on the SAME harness: clean 0.796 (250) / 0.840 (125 lite), robust ~0.728 (125 lite); oracle-1.5x = 1.000 -> every scene capturable-by-construction.
data: game_theory_expert_hard_300.pt (300 qualified/417 attempts) and hard_600.pt (600 qualified/798 attempts).

v11_legacy_policy_on_hard_lite.note: never trained on hard scenes; cross-scene transfer

results.summary: IQLD family on hard tops out ~0.39-0.55 nominal across BC-only / offline distill / cross-scene transfer / larger data / better init. ONLINE fine-tuning on hard DEGRADES (naive and calibrated), unlike legacy where the calibrated recipe held init level.

root_cause_analysis: Hard scenes apply real difficulty to IQLD: the evader (faster, private goal) escapes in ~47-60% of IQLD episodes vs ~20% vs the teacher - IQLD loses the early interception race.

Teacher's hard-scene edge is closed-loop game-theoretic: interceptor/flank assignment replanned at a 0.75 s horizon every step. Distillation captures single-step actions but not this reactive re-planning; at ~0.5-0.55 offline IQLD is at an imitation ceiling independent of data size (300 vs 600) and init (random vs v11).

Online recovery is unstable in the hard regime: low per-rollout success (~50%) means the online mixture trains mostly on failed trajectories with large negative returns (bimodal returns), sparse capture reward; the Cal-QL/OVM anchors are frozen values from a weak 0.5-level init and do not stabilise as they did on legacy (where success was ~90%).
Result is method/recipe-level, NOT environmental: the same scenes are 100% oracle-1.5x solvable, teacher 0.84, so headroom exists; IQLD+this online recipe cannot harvest it.
answer: NO - IQLD (offline distillation) + the implemented online fine-tune (Cal-QL alpha=1.0/lambda=0.3/OVM/guard, ups=10, anneal 1.0->0.3) does NOT exceed the expert baseline on hard scenes: best IQLD nominal ~0.51-0.55 vs teacher 0.84 (same-harness lite), and online fine-tuning actively degrades (to 0.16-0.36) instead of recovering.
what_would_be_needed: closed-loop/self-generated online learning at higher update ratio with high success-rate exploration (e.g. SAC/RLPD-style, curriculum from legacy-like easy scenes to hard)
distilling an explicit role/interceptor re-planning controller rather than 1:1 imitation
or accept hard-scene benchmark as measuring closed-loop advantage beyond current IQLD recipe
